title: Root class spans the normalized stalk cotangent space
statement: Take i:U->L, a finite G-torsor W over U [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois], Spec R->L and a cartesian chart beta identifying U times_L Spec R with D(f). Let b:R->H, H Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], g=b(f) regular, H/(g) a domain, and n=|G| a unit. Set A=H[t]/(t^n-g), N=Spec A and V=D(g). Suppose N locally Noetherian. Let p be the displayed pullback torsor over V [def-pc-fibre-product], finite etale [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism], a=p followed by V->N, and suppose its relative normalization [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization] finite. At any normalization point x whose base prime is (t), assume the base stalk is regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Write C for the normalization stalk, m its maximal ideal, and tau for the image under the structural stalk map of the germ of the explicit root t. Then m is contained in (tau)+m^2. No divisor centre or generic point is in this assertion. Scheme and localization conventions are [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]; residue conventions are [def-weil-residue-field, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension].

proof.text:
Write n=|G| and t for the root. The hypothesis identifies the base prime
with (t), so its stalk is A_(t). Since g is regular and H/(g) is a domain,
H_(g) is a DVR with uniformizer g. The monic root algebra is free over H,
the equation t^n=g makes t regular, and A/(t)=H/(g). Thus the regular local
ring A_(t) is a DVR with uniformizer t, and its extension over H_(g) has
ramification index n. The cartesian chart beta restricts W to a G-torsor on
D(f); localizing at (g) gives a G-torsor on the fraction field of H_(g).
Each connected factor is Galois for its stabilizer subgroup in G. By 09EB,
its ramification index divides the stabilizer order, which divides n, and
its residue extension is separable because n is invertible. The factors are
tame. Abhyankar 0BRM for the index-n root extension makes the normalized
base-change factors adically formally smooth. The index-one implication of
09E7 says that the valuation of t in each factor is one. By 0307, localizing
the concrete relative normalization gives precisely these integral closures;
further localization at x gives their DVR local rings, with the displayed
structural stalk map. Every element of their maximal ideal is therefore a
multiple of the image of t. Passing to the quotient by the square of that
ideal gives the asserted cotangent spanning statement. Only this first-order
conclusion is retained; the caller uses Noetherianity and Nakayama to recover
ideal generation. No Cartier centre, divisor generic point, or comparison
with the base maximal ideal occurs in this statement. For n=1 the root base
change is the identity and the same tame calculation applies. Empty factors
have no x and give no assertion.

lean.statement:
theorem root_normalization_cotangent_root
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R)
    (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
    (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ)
    (H : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing H] (b : R ⟶ H)
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : H)) (hg : IsSMulRegular H (b.hom f))
    [IsDomain (H ⧸ Ideal.span {b.hom f})] :
    let g := b.hom f
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    ∀ (hN : IsLocallyNoetherian N),
    letI := hN
    let p := pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ)
    ∀ (hp : IsFinite p),
    letI := hp
    let a := p ≫ V.ι
    Etale p → IsFinite a.fromNormalization →
    ∀ (x : a.normalization),
      (a.fromNormalization x).asIdeal = Ideal.span
        {AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)} →
      IsRegularLocalRing (N.presheaf.stalk (a.fromNormalization x)) →
      let C := a.normalization.presheaf.stalk x
      let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C
      let t := AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.toStalk A (a.fromNormalization x)
        (AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g))
      m ≤ Ideal.span {(a.fromNormalization.stalkMap x).hom t} ⊔ m * m
